I replied in #coastal-team: the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was November 3, 2025.

Two sources back that date. Moss's Nov 2, 2025 Coastal digest says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap note, dated Dec 8, 2025, also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff.

The recap adds that Bettina kept running PHL day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22, 2025. I gave both dates in the reply so she can pick the right one for the tracker.
